scope: Bounded broader native-table/layout development trial; no accepted labels or held-out accuracy.
selection_policy: Previously reviewed Form 49A page 4 control; ITR manual middle page 21 and its immediate neighbors 20/22; longer 13-page form middle page 7 and neighbors 6/8. Fixed before this run, no outcome-based substitution. All originals were seen previously.
prior_exposure: The control and ITR page 21 were inspected; ITR 20/22 were not processed in source-transfer-v4. All thirteen pages of the longer form were previously natively extracted, without table acceptance. Related forms are development data.
